about: Events found by the weekly search for Kilted Farmers Pasta Highlanders. The Highlanders page and the kitchen Hub read this file. Check each event with its organizer before booking.

events.name: Mason Christmas Craft Show
events.place: Ingham County Fairgrounds, Community Building, 700 E Ash St
events.notes: Three-day indoor show (Thu-Fri 9am-7pm, Sat 9am-5pm). Food is a listed vendor category; organizer contact isn't public on the listing.

events.name: Women in the Arts Festival
events.place: Edgewood United Church, 469 N Hagadorn Rd
events.notes: 50+ booths. Organizer contact isn't on the listing.

events.name: November Saline Craft Show
events.place: Saline Middle School
events.notes: Shoppers pay $5 admission. Organizer contact isn't on the listing.

events.name: Mrs. Claus's Purse Arts & Crafts Show
events.place: Trinity Episcopal Church, 101 E Mansion St
events.notes: Indoor holiday handmade show, 9am-3pm. The listing doesn't mention food vendors, so ask the church first; it's this Saturday.

events.name: Michigan Center Craft and Vendor Show
events.place: Michigan Center Bible Church, 150 Broad St
events.notes: Indoor show, 9am-3pm, and food is a listed vendor type. It's this Saturday, so call soon if you want a spot.

events.name: Harper Holly Days Craft Show and Fundraiser
events.place: Harper Creek High School, 12677 Beadle Lake Rd
events.notes: Two-day school fundraiser show, 9am-3pm. The listing has a food booth category but organizer contact isn't public.

events.name: Dimondale Holiday Craft Show
events.place: Chief Okemos Sportsmans Club, 4667 N Gunnell Rd
events.notes: Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-4pm. Bakers and food are listed vendor types.

events.name: Jingle Bling Craft and Vendor Show
events.place: Dexter Lake Church, 1555 E Michigan Ave
events.notes: Big indoor show with 100+ vendors and "tasty treats", 9am-3pm. Ask the organizer about packaged food.

events.name: Coldwater Christmas Crafters Market
events.place: Coldwater High School, 275 N Fremont St
events.notes: 80+ crafters and vendors, 9am-3pm, and food is a listed vendor type.

events.name: Small Business Saturday Craft Show
events.place: Westwood Mall, 1850 W Michigan Ave
events.notes: Indoor mall show, 11am-6pm, that names bakers and food vendors among its sellers. A separate, earlier show from the Dec 19 Westwood one.

events.name: Merry Mile at the Calhoun County Fairgrounds
events.schedule: Eggnog Jog Dec 2; then Thu-Sun Dec 3-20 and nightly Dec 21-27 (closed Christmas), 5:30-9pm
events.place: Calhoun County Fairgrounds, 720 Fair St
events.notes: Evening holiday event with food booths; food vendor spots are open until full. Ask Cathy whether bagged pasta fits their food booths.

events.name: KindleFest
events.place: Kerrytown District
events.notes: Outdoor German-style holiday market with vendors, traditional food and food trucks. The apply link is a Kerrytown District member letter, so check whether outside vendors can join.

events.name: Winter Art Market
events.place: York Food & Drink
events.notes: Food-friendly venue.

events.name: Christmas Market - Calling All Vendors!
events.place: Chateau Aeronautique Winery / Blue Skies Brewery, 12000 Pentecost Hwy
events.notes: Holiday market at an Irish Hills winery and brewery that's actively looking for vendors. A food-friendly crowd; fees aren't listed.

events.name: Eaton Rapids Hometown Family Christmas Craft Show
events.place: First United Methodist Church, 600 S Main St
events.notes: Cozy church show with about 35 vendors, 10am-4pm. Food is a listed vendor type.

events.name: Jackson Vendor and Craft Show
events.place: St. John Elementary School, 405 E North St
events.notes: Indoor school show, 9am-3pm, $2 admission. There's a food booth category; contact isn't public on the listing.

events.name: Christmas Tack-O-Rama and Craft Show
events.place: Northwest Early Elementary, 3737 Lansing Ave
events.notes: Local vendors, a food truck and hot dog concession, 9am-2pm. Ask whether packaged food is welcome alongside them.

events.name: Indoor Christmas Market
events.place: Dr. Browne Rec Center
events.notes: City-run indoor market with food trucks alongside vendors. Vendor space is limited, so reach out soon.

events.name: Winter Market at Motawi Tileworks
events.place: Motawi Tileworks, 170 W Enterprise Dr
events.notes: One-day holiday market, 10am-5pm. Food vendor policy isn't listed, so ask first.

events.name: Deck the Halls Craft Show
events.place: Grand Ledge Public Schools Administration Building, 220 Lamson St
events.notes: Holiday show, 10am-4pm, with candies and cookies among the goods, so food fits.

events.name: DeWitt Merry Market
events.place: 119 and 125 N Bridge St
events.notes: Downtown makers market with food trucks, 10am-3pm. Food is a listed vendor type.

events.name: Tiny Expo Indie Art & Craft Fair
events.place: Ann Arbor District Library, Downtown
events.notes: Library-run indie handmade fair with an online application. Food vendor policy isn't listed, so ask first.

events.name: M+Co Holiday Popup Market
events.place: 135 E Chicago Blvd
events.notes: Downtown Tecumseh holiday pop-up the Friday before Christmas. Vendor details aren't on the listing; check the Eventbrite page.

events.name: Allen Street Market
events.notes: Year-round indoor farmers market. Vendor applications are listed as opening later, so worth watching.
